files.name: cnpc_tacz_fire-0.1.2.jar
files.html:
Added

  • Added NPC ranged accuracy support.
  • Added NPC walking speed controls while firing.
  • Added script API for setting NPC accuracy.

Changed

  • Improved the configuration UI for better readability and usability.

Fixed

  • Fixed melee range being treated as the actual attack reach.
  • Fixed custom gun reload state not being detected correctly.
